completion_text: The containment warden falls. Its emergency return circuit is still carrying a signal toward Retained Fen.

records.title: Separated specimens
records.text: Red chambers feed warmth into familiar boars. Blue chambers slow their responses. Each pen carries one influence; the dividers have never held a paired specimen.

records.title: A later human hand
records.text: Human-sized tools lie beside a newer control panel. The operator's handprint branches into the same mineral scar as the specimens. Scratched instructions divert collection lines into living hosts; the original shutdown sequence is crossed out: KEEP THE RETURN CIRCUIT LIVE.

records.title: Emergency return circuit
records.text: The diagram ties the containment warden to an emergency return line. If containment fails, the line discharges into the Retained Fen collectors. A margin note reads: the operator returns first; the retained ground answers afterward.

design_purpose.stage_labels: Give existing Trial rooms a coherent laboratory purpose without changing their route or reward identity.
design_purpose.specimens: One existing single-influence creature replaces the first opponent in each branch of the first two stages.
design_purpose.apparatus_size_m: A solid containment cabinet fits in the room's outer alcove and participates in navigation clearance.
design_purpose.apparatus_offset_m: Keep apparatus clear of the ordinary entrance, central fight and offering approach.
design_purpose.record_spacing_m: Separate the three inspectable entry-gallery records for ordinary walking and E interaction.
